detail: Conversational assistant implemented and verified with mocked provider and data access plus a canned-API browser observation; no live Gemini call; automatic completion remains inconclusive without applicable calibration
manual:
Observed on 2026-11-12 in headless Chromium (Playwright) against the production build served locally (`fixture-capture.js` holds the script and the canned data). The API was replaced by canned responses: one answer with a list and three listing cards, one plain answer, and one 503 failure. The listing images are the placeholder because the canned listings carry none. No real backend, database or Gemini request was involved, so this shows the screen, not the quality of the answers.

Also checked by the script at 360, 1280 and 1920 px: after a reload in the same tab the thread was still on the page, and the document had no horizontal overflow; no page errors were raised.

A first capture showed the message box and the composer pushed below the fold at 360 px and then a sticky composer that covered the last messages; both were replaced by a fixed-height message box (38% of the viewport, at least 240 px) with the composer below it and room above the floating chat button. At 360 x 740 the site header still takes about 240 px, so the composer is at the fold and needs one scroll.

Not observed: a real Gemini answer, listings from a real database, a phone or any browser other than Chromium, keyboard use of the starters and the retry button (covered by the component tests only), dark mode (not implemented).
history: Chat endpoint with function calling, redaction and local fallback, and the chat screen implemented; backend and frontend suites and the build pass; observed at 360, 1280 and 1920 px with canned responses
limitations: The Gemini request and function-calling exchange were never sent to the real API; they are verified against mocks only
The listing search was tested with a mocked Product model, not against MongoDB
Browser observation used canned API responses in headless Chromium at 360, 1280 and 1920 px; no real phone or other browser
Answer quality and tone from the real model were not judged

AC-CHAT-06-1.note: Backend tests pass: the conversation is sent as alternating roles with the system instruction and tool, the tool query filters on active status, eligible sellers, price and condition, a text-index miss falls back to a keyword match, and the listings come back as cards; the real provider and database were not involved

AC-CHAT-06-2.note: Backend tests pass: emails, phone numbers and links are absent from what the provider receives, tool results contain only category, condition, description, price and title with the redaction placeholders, unknown tools are refused, the provider failing returns a local answer with degraded true, and the switch restores topic-only requests

AC-WEB-22-1.note: 11 component tests pass (starters, Enter and Shift+Enter, IME, cards, retry, persistence across a remount, new conversation, sign-out); the screen was observed with canned responses at 360, 1280 and 1920 px without horizontal overflow
